specs.title: P03 local form errors focus fields, backend rejection stays inline and hides raw private text
P03 lost committed response explicitly retries original idempotency key and creates only one run
P03 snapshot becomes blocked before submission; no C03 command leaves browser
P03 narrowed authority and offline clear form; explicit recovery never replays
P03 cursor expiration and rate limit need explicit retry, never auto repeat
P03 read-only identity cannot create and checking state reveals no form
P03 review scope acknowledgment, step navigation and guarded discard keep draft memory only
